maximum_depth_rule: All three reviewed rows remain raw maximum-depth records because they are public comments and prefectural responses about the 2025 partial plan change, not the revised KPI table, annual actuals, or an official achievement assessment.
version_boundary: The 2022-2026 plan, its original targets, the 2025 partial-change proposal and adopted revisions, annual policy evaluation, progress sheets, and resident-satisfaction results remain separate source and evaluation units.
non_goals: Do not treat a public comment or prefectural response as a KPI actual.
Do not reconstruct any of the thirteen revised indicator values from comment text.
Do not merge original and revised plan versions without reviewed source tables.
Do not replace missing units or split mixed comment-and-response text by inference.
Do not calculate achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
